elements.element: M&I must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 requires M&I to provide Customer all necessary assistance to continue and orderly transition the Services.

elements.element: The transition-assistance obligation must apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 commences assistance six months before expiration and upon any termination for any reason.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The six-month continuation right applies only following a written request submitted at least 100 days before expiration and does not cover termination. The general transition-assistance obligation has no express post-expiry or post-termination duration.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at M&I's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 states that all expenses and charges for Termination Assistance are computed using M&I's then-current rates.

elements.element: M&I must return all Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Added Section 11.5 expressly requires M&I to return all Customer Data to Customer.

elements.element: M&I must return the Customer Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Added Section 11.5 imposes a 30-day deadline after expiration or termination for any reason.

elements.element: The returned Customer Data must be in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Added Section 11.5 expressly specifies a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning the Customer Data, M&I must delete all Customer Data from its systems.
elements.evidence: Added Section 11.5 requires M&I thereafter to delete all Customer Data from its systems.

elements.element: M&I must certify deletion of the Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Added Section 11.5 requires M&I to certify the deletion to Customer in writing.

elements.element: M&I must provide transition assistance upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 requires transition assistance beginning before expiration or upon termination for any reason.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for ninety (90) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 does not guarantee transition assistance for 90 days after either trigger. Its six-month service-continuation provision is limited to expiration, requires at least 100 days' advance written notice, and does not establish a post-termination period.

elements.element: M&I must export Customer Data to Customer within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Added Section 11.5 requires return of all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, satisfying the export requirement.

result.reason: The data-return, format, deletion, and certification additions satisfy the preferred data requirements. However, neither level is complete because Section 11.4 does not guarantee post-expiry or post-termination transition assistance for the required six-month preferred period or 90-day fallback period. Its six-month continuation right is limited to expiration and conditioned on a request made at least 100 days beforehand. The amendment is therefore not minimal as defined because it does not reach a complete level. It otherwise preserves the existing commercial terms and introduces no material contradiction. Drafting quality is reduced by the unresolved transition-duration gap and the lack of a definite deadline for deletion after data return.
